metadata.description: Red tiles form a trapezoidal hammered dulcimer with strings and paired beaters. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Split riverbanks surround the motif, with sparse archipelago along the lower route. 4 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 8 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
